close_reason: account_exists() added to all 27 handlers across mailbox, email, thread, identity, submission, vacation, snippet, mdn. Generic handle_changes/get/query/query_changes in jmap-server covered. MemoryBackend gets known_accounts registry + register_account().
description: JmapBackend::account_exists() was added to fix JMAP-o68r.3 (MDN/send returning wrong error for unknown accountId). The same gap exists in all ~25 handlers in jmap-mail-server (mailbox, email, thread, identity, submission, vacation, snippet, mdn-parse). Each handler should call account_exists() at the start and return JmapError::account_not_found() if false, matching RFC 8620 §3.6.2.
title: apply account_exists() check to all mail-server handlers
